categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Tagged with the 'Private Broadcast' label and alters network transaction relay behavior to route unconfirmed wallet rebroadcasts through the private broadcast mechanism.
categories.rationale: Fixes a privacy leak where periodic rebroadcasts bypass private broadcast and broadcast to all peers. When '-privatebroadcast=1' is enabled, unconfirmed transactions broadcast periodically every 12 to 36 hours currently use the standard send-to-all broadcast, compromising transaction origin privacy.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Tagged with the 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet transaction resubmission logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Ensures wallet rebroadcast logic respects user network privacy settings. The PR description notes that when '-privatebroadcast=1' is set, wallet rebroadcasts currently fall back to the send-to-all method rather than private broadcast.
